field: B2B SaaS · developer and operations tooling
designChallenge: Density and credibility. A technical buyer needs to compare three plans, scan six features, and believe the performance claims. Decoration reads as a lack of substance here, but so does a generic Tailwind landing page.
prompt: This is the marketing site for Cadence, a warehouse-native analytics layer sold to operations and data teams. It is currently plain and generic. Redesign the site so it is genuinely distinctive and worth shipping.
preserve: All five nav links and their targets
All six features with their names and descriptions
The four performance metrics with exact values
All three pricing plans, their prices, unit labels, feature lists, and a working call-to-action each
The working monthly/annual billing toggle, including the 20% annual discount calculation
All four FAQ questions and answers, expandable
The signup form with email field and its success state
